title: RC 电路的充电（零状态响应）
statement: 图示电路中 U_s = 10 V，R = 2 kΩ，C = 100 µF，电容原来不带电。开关 S 在 t = 0 时闭合。
求充电电流 i 的初值 i(0₊)、时间常数 τ，以及 t = 0.4 s 时的 u_C。

questions.explain: u_C(0₊) = u_C(0₋) = 0，换路瞬间电容相当于短路，电源电压全部加在 R 上：i(0₊) = 10 V / 2 kΩ = 5 mA。

questions.ask: 工程上一般认为过渡过程大约经过多长时间就结束了？
choices: 永远不会结束，所以无法估计
约 2 s（10τ）以后才能认为结束
choiceExplain: 1τ 时 u_C 只达到终值的 63.2%，离终值还差三分之一以上，过渡过程远没有结束。
数学上指数项确实永远不为零，但它衰减得很快：5τ 时只剩 0.7%，工程上用 3τ～5τ 估计就够了。
10τ 过于保守：5τ 时已达到终值的 99.3%，再等下去几乎没有变化。
questions.explain: t = 3τ 时 u_C 已达到终值的 95%，5τ 时达到 99.3%，工程上认为 3τ～5τ 后过渡过程结束，即约 0.6～1 s。

hints: 电容原来不带电，换路瞬间电容电压不能跃变，此时电容相当于短路。
零状态响应：u_C(t) = u_C(∞)(1 − e^(−t/τ))，其中 τ = RC。
solution: **2. 终值。** 充电结束后电容开路，i(∞) = 0，u_C(∞) = U_s = 10 V。
**5. 过渡过程的长短。** 1τ 时达到终值的 63.2%，3τ 时 95.0%，5τ 时 99.3%；工程上取 3τ～5τ，即约 0.6～1 s。

en.title: Charging an RC circuit (zero-state response)
statement: In the circuit, U_s = 10 V, R = 2 kΩ, C = 100 µF, and the capacitor is initially uncharged. Switch S closes at t = 0.
Find the initial charging current i(0+), the time constant τ, and u_C at t = 0.4 s.

questions.explain: u_C(0+) = u_C(0−) = 0, so at the instant of switching the capacitor acts like a short and the whole source voltage is across R: i(0+) = 10 V / 2 kΩ = 5 mA.

questions.ask: In engineering practice, after roughly how long is the transient considered over?
choices: It never ends, so it can't be estimated
choiceExplain: At 1τ u_C has reached only 63.2% of its final value — more than a third is still to go, so the transient is far from over.
Mathematically the exponential never reaches zero, but it decays fast: at 5τ only 0.7% is left, so engineers use 3τ–5τ.
10τ is overly cautious: at 5τ u_C is already at 99.3% of its final value and hardly changes afterwards.
questions.explain: At t = 3τ u_C has reached 95 % of its final value, at 5τ 99.3 %; engineers regard the transient as over after 3τ–5τ, i.e. about 0.6–1 s.

hints: The capacitor starts uncharged and its voltage can't jump, so at t = 0+ it behaves like a short circuit.
Zero-state response: u_C(t) = u_C(∞)(1 − e^(−t/τ)) with τ = RC.
solution: **1. Initial value.** Switching rule: u_C(0+) = u_C(0−) = 0. KVL: U_s = R·i(0+) + u_C(0+), so i(0+) = 10 / 2000 = **5 mA**.
**2. Final value.** When charging is complete the capacitor is an open circuit: i(∞) = 0, u_C(∞) = U_s = 10 V.
**3. Time constant.** τ = RC = 2 kΩ × 100 µF = **0.2 s**.
**5. How long the transient lasts.** After 1τ the response reaches 63.2 % of its final value, after 3τ 95.0 %, after 5τ 99.3 %; in practice 3τ–5τ, i.e. about 0.6–1 s.
